body.intent: The daemon runs any workflow, built-in or bring-your-own, from start to finish with no orchestrator beside it: it enforces host limits on child sessions and their tests, detects and recovers stalled steps, keeps the box healthy before and after runs, retries failed runs from the right step with their findings, hands planners the notes queued with a request, and records every outside intervention so intervention stays the exception. Brief with the owner's words: /home/rhiza/orchestrator/hands-off-milestone-interview.md
